relationships.rule: (type,group,instance) identifies a record; DBPF has no path/name table.
parseDbpfIndex -> extractDbpfRecord -> WorldObject or CellResource parser.
Typed instance ref; playerSize selects a scale band and startTile is a level flag.
Typed Cell instance IDs; non-null refs validate against real Cell records.
Scale bucket selects current/next ID; target type/group and payload are UNKNOWN.
OpenSpore maps scale to buckets 1..10, exact match first, then -1 default; next advect uses bucket+1.
Original slots point to 16-byte cCellDataReference objects; current OpenSpore stores simplified 4-byte IDs.
A separate 0x612B3191 record supplies scale-keyed color; exact original selector is not in the decoded world record.
PreloadResources calls Cell and populate preload paths; model/texture/creature/effect vectors feed live presentation.
Live Cell objects are pool-allocated and referenced by foreground/background query entries.
Current source classifies it as model-group/part definition data, not placement.
Markers have z/count/type/size controls but no x/y; an original placement function must generate coordinates if this interpretation is correct.
One model definition can back many pool/Gfx instances distinguished by index and transform.
Manager vectors/maps own intrusive star records.
Star record owns generated/schema planet records.
Live cPlanet has a PlanetID-compatible key and parent; cSolarSystem separately owns live cPlanet objects.
mpPlanetRecord links the live wrapper to generated schema/state.
cPlanet owns mpVisiblePlanet; cVisiblePlanet has a back-pointer.
cPlanetGfx holds a planet pointer and visual-effect vector entries.
Each record has type, explicit position, health/ammo/loot, ResourceKey, and flags.
Planet state embeds civilization/tribe model, political, wealth, population, position, and food data.
Generated terrain ResourceKey is the stable planet-to-surface handoff; producer/container key are UNKNOWN.
cPlanetModel holds ITerrain pointers; ToSurface is a named transition surface with 55 direct callers.
Sphere owns six full/low-res quads, eleven map slots, weather, state, and texture maps.
ITerrain exposes add/remove/has/reset methods; records carry transform and ResourceKey.
mpHighLODPlanetSim is the Space-stage planet simulation handle.
Direct active pointers plus mPlayerColonies vector.
Scan maps, encountered IDs, spice timer, explored/TScore and PlanetID exist; owner key/stream order UNKNOWN.
Get returns persistence manager; vtable exposes LoadGame. Exact transaction and stream order are UNKNOWN.
Planet dirty/edit flags and terrain footprint/relevel/player-effect vectors expose mutation surfaces.

events.action: Resource and Simulator managers become available.
Establish sCellGame/sCellGFX/sCellUI; initialize Cell pools/state and render worlds/layers.
Resolve typed refs and preload Cell/populate models, textures, creatures and effects.
Select foreground/background worlds, level entries, start tile and current/next advect data.
Activate display, UI, input, world and simulation.
Frame update dispatches movement, Cell create/update, AI, graphics, effects, queries and world state.
Reset mode/background state, then release pools, GFX and UI.
Load six entity group/instance/transform records with identity and position provenance.
Parse one content package; no multi-package precedence exists.
Load UI, create eight world tokens and store scene model pairs.
Start display and bind entities to projected main model world 0x1010020.
Fetch GMDL, convert mesh 0, bake vertex formats and check expected counts.
Run fixed, scripted or interactive host path; CellSim is independent of decoded world/populate records.
Destroy frame handles after frame/fence safety, run OnExit/Dispose and shut down GPU/WSI.

lifecycle.fidelity: Clean-room host shell, not an observed original transition order.

events.action: cStarManager owns star grids/saved/starter records; each cStarRecord owns planet records.
Create and populate scores, species, commodities, civ/tribe records, planet objects and terrain key.
Select active cPlanet and link record, model/world, low-LOD sim, visible planet, effects and parent.
Enter surface mode and reach terrain helpers.
Load/generate sphere, map set, textures, LOD quads, state/weather, models, transforms and relevel data.
High-LOD simulation and land/atmosphere/decal passes update environment.
Add/remove/reset model footprints, relevel entries and player effects.
Release surface models/effects/terrain before or during return to Space.

reconstruction_packages.scope: Recover and implement marker-to-x/y/actor materialization using seed, scale, z, type, count and shape fields.
reconstruction_packages.stop: No stable x/y claim from marker bytes alone.

reconstruction_packages.title: WorldObject field schema
reconstruction_packages.scope: Decode 0x0F43029A c-entry order, GUID/model relationships and D/E body fields.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Retain names/vectors only if field order remains unproven.

reconstruction_packages.title: Planet record model
reconstruction_packages.scope: cPlanetRecord generation, PlanetID/group identity, scores, species, commodities, civ/tribe and planet objects.
reconstruction_packages.stop: No original generation formula from names/layout alone.

reconstruction_packages.title: Space-to-surface handoff
reconstruction_packages.scope: cPlanetModel::ToSurface, generated terrain key, ITerrain load/generate and return-to-Space ownership.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Do not merge cPlanetModel and cTerrainSphere into one object.

reconstruction_packages.title: Planet population and civilization
reconstruction_packages.stop: Static vectors do not establish generation or ownership.

reconstruction_packages.title: Planet persistence
reconstruction_packages.scope: PlayerPlanetData, cStarRecord, cSolarSystem, cSimulatorSpaceGame, cStarManager databases and LoadGame ordering.
reconstruction_packages.stop: No round-trip fidelity claim from vtable names.

reconstruction_packages.title: Terrain render lifecycle
reconstruction_packages.scope: cTerrainSphere/quad/map/weather/state load, LOD, land/water/seabed/atmosphere/decal/reflection passes and material inputs.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Generic IRenderer draws do not replace original terrain rendering.

reconstruction_packages.title: Planet/terrain editor
reconstruction_packages.scope: Model footprints, relevel/player modifications, dirty flags, commit/undo and play-mode restore.
reconstruction_packages.stop: No editor replacement interface before ownership and event order are known.

reconstruction_packages.title: Identity resolver
reconstruction_packages.scope: DBPF type/group/instance to Cell actor/model, planet asset and generated terrain semantics.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Do not infer names from opaque IDs or geometry alone.

provenance.determinism: All arrays use fixed logical order by ID; no hash-map/set iteration order is serialized.
provenance.ghidra_operations: Read-only metadata, layouts, caller/callee queries, and bounded static-body summaries only; no save/change and no decompiled code reproduced.
provenance.kg_operations: SQLite read-only URI only; no rows changed.
provenance.source_policy: Only committed repository files and live read-only Ghidra/KG evidence were used. Untracked research artifacts were excluded as authority.
